scope: Static original source; no operation performed on hardware
conditions: Normal entry and normal return through the decoded control flow
Every encountered memory/CSR access completes and every busy poll eventually observes its tested bit clear
No unmodelled asynchronous register or control-flow interference
Fresh reads are separate observations; no assumption that MMIO or stack values stay constant between reads

helpers.effects: One SW32(base+12,A0) at18E94; no status read
Fresh CTRL read/setbit17/write; align A0 down256; write A0 to+20; fresh CTRL read/setbit6/write; unbounded status bit0 poll; fresh CTRL read/clearbit17/write

helpers.inputs: A0=D,A1=S; entry A2 is not a length input
helpers.effects: Fresh CTRL setbit16; status bit0 then bit1 polls; 64 ordered LW32(S+i),SW32(align(D)+i),status bit1 polls for i=0,4,...252; fresh CTRL setbit21; status bit0 poll; fresh CTRL clearbit16

normal_outputs.A6: lastSourceREAD32(S+252) at18F1E, before last per-word poll

normal_outputs.A1: fresh source pointer read from private frameSP+12
normal_outputs.A6: last source word from source selected by fresh frame reload

wrapper.preserved: S0/S1/RA restored from fresh frame loads; SP restored arithmetically; other nonlisted GPRs never written directly or by the five helpers
wrapper.CSR_warning: Clears mask136 then sets mask136. Does not read/save/restore the prior CSR800 value. No claim about architectural interrupt semantics or pointwise interrupt behavior.
wrapper.stack_warning: A replacement that holds A1 only in a register removes the original fresh SP+12 read. Exact stack layout, store order and fresh restore values are separate integration obligations.

native_compile_gates.suggested_profile: Existing proven RV32IMAC/ILP32 Clang -Oz, no relax, machine outliner disabled; use the existing compiler worker's pinned actual profile
required_static_checks: C and C++ actual machine bytes and full instruction coverage
Per-function encoded destination sets equal source ledger, not merely ordinary C calling convention
No helper stack/calls/RA write or hidden outlined code
Exact fresh read/write widths, order, busy branches and normal output residues
Original five direct JAL target geometry, frame and CSR sequence
Whole-image section/ref/symbol/alias ownership and incoming interior references before integration
native_compile_gates.ordinary_C_limit: A readable void C helper does not inherently retain original A0/A1/A2/A3/A4/A5/A6 residues. HOST callbacks prove values/order only; native register contracts require raw compiled proof.

nonreturn_and_unknowns: Original busy polls have no timeout, error code, retry budget or cancellation branch
If a poll never clears, later operations, lock, CSR set and return do not occur
HOST budget exhaustion must report an explicit unknown/nonreturn boundary with only the observed prefix; it must not invent an original timeout return
All decoded data accesses are 32-bit LW/SW. Numeric RV32 address addition wraps modulo2^32; physical alias, source alignment/fault behavior and actual valid memory are unproved
No MMIO error-bit decision or success return is decoded; aligned A0 is not a success code
Fresh volatile observations and final register residues do not prove pointwise asynchronous/IRQ equivalence
Chip identity, ROM implementation, physical Flash geometry, write completion, timing, recoverability and OTA readiness remain unproved
Only the admitted 9D00 continuation has a bounded liveness observation; other known or computed callers are not claimed dead for these registers
Older runtime/BOOT addresses are not transferred as proof for ID2966
